artifacts.summary: 4-phase documentation-only plan implementing the refined middle ruling: bless synchronous nested delegation, prohibit outright (not bound) an async/backgrounded subagent dispatch awaited across a turn boundary; plus a durable ruling record, cross-reference pointers, a dispatch-liveness probe diagnostic, and a redeploy/full-gate phase.

memory_candidates.content: When a documentation edit targets a file that a lint script greps for exact literal strings (the generated-copy-source pattern: lint reads expected bullet text from a canonical fragment at runtime via `grep -F ... | head -n1`), adding new prose to that fragment can silently break the lint by introducing a second match that head -n1 then picks. Before editing such a fragment, re-derive the grepped literals' occurrence counts, and make the post-edit count assertion part of the phase's own verification rather than relying on the lint's exit code alone -- a head -n1 collision can still exit 0 while comparing against the wrong line.
